description: Representation-native Galilean transport. The system's native stable-identity body is given a uniform initial velocity in zero gravity and rolled out through the released pipeline. Uniform motion must remain uniform: the center of mass advects along a straight line at constant speed in the declared direction, while the stable-identity shape metrics (edge lengths, areas) stay at their rest values. This isolates advection/transfer fidelity (grid-crossing noise, transport dissipation, spurious forces) from constitutive response: no force acts, so any deviation is an implementation artifact. The declared direction is deliberately oblique to the native grid axes so cell-crossing error cannot hide along a lattice direction.

initial_conditions.note: Direction is normalized by the submitter and applied in its native simulation frame; the exported center-of-mass path must advance along this direction in scene coordinates. Speed is native (unit-free scoring): the scorer checks straightness, speed constancy, direction, and a minimum travel gate, not an absolute speed.

pass_criteria.quantity: uniform-motion transport of center of mass and stable-identity shape

provenance.reference_formula: x_com(t) = x_com(0) + v t with constant v parallel to the declared direction; all stable-identity edge lengths and areas constant
regime_assumptions: zero gravity and no boundary contact during the rollout
stable identity: the same physical element keeps the same index in every frame
straightness = max perpendicular deviation of the COM from the best-fit line through first and last COM, divided by total travel
speed variation = max |per-frame COM displacement - median per-frame displacement| / median per-frame displacement, over uniform-cadence checkpoints
provenance.notes: Frozen v1. Submission contract is triangle_metrics.csv exactly as SPEC 2.6 (stable triangle soups export it natively; other stable-identity representations may compute the same columns over their own persistent element structure and declare the mapping in meta.json). A natural controlled fault is leaving the engine's default gravity enabled: the COM path becomes parabolic and the straightness check fails while shape metrics remain healthy.
